decisions.decision: Milestone v1.3 named 'Nonprod Environment & CI Hardening'

Bundle scope confirmed: nonprod env + CI gate, PLUS Dependabot github-actions ecosystem entry, TruffleHog CI pass, GitHub Actions digest-pinning, gradle cache in run-tests, gitleaks-in-worktree fix, security-scan.yml stale-comment cleanup, session cookie Secure flag (now that real TLS exists), README architecture-showcase expansion
decisions.rationale: User chose 'Bundle in other ready todos' when asked scope-narrow vs scope-wide

decisions.decision: Colocate nonprod on the existing Netcup VPS (not a second VPS) as the default plan
decisions.rationale: Research measured ~2.65GB unreserved headroom under current prod caps; a second VPS is the documented fallback (~EUR4/month Netcup VPS Lite 1) if live measurement after first nonprod deploy shows it doesn't fit -- this is NOT yet decided with the user, it's the research recommendation to present at requirements time

decisions.decision: Research recommends a SECOND Redpanda broker instance for nonprod, not topic-name-prefixing on the shared prod broker
decisions.rationale: This codebase's Avro Schema Registry uses RecordNameStrategy keyed by class name, not topic -- prefixing topics would still leave the registry shared, so a nonprod schema-evolution test could mutate prod's registered compatibility history

decisions.decision: Research recommends stable long-lived nonprod (not per-PR ephemeral environments)
decisions.rationale: Per-PR environments solve a parallel-review-contention problem a solo project structurally doesn't have -- flagged as an anti-feature for this scale

decisions.decision: Research flags 'backend gates its own prod promotion on the frontend repo's E2E results' (the original todo's framing) as a probable anti-pattern
decisions.rationale: Inverts ownership/coupling -- recommended alternative is the frontend repo gates itself on nonprod reachability instead (nonprod deploys continuously on every push, so it's already a stable target). This needs to be surfaced as an explicit decision point during requirements definition -- not yet confirmed with the user

decisions.rationale: Hard-blocked on the frontend repo existing -- there is no workflow file to dispatch into yet. Research's suggested 5th phase is this, explicitly marked do-not-attempt
